module.purpose: Provides application-service operations for requesting, completing, and retrieving verified email and phone resources for users and teams.
module.summary: This injectable service coordinates verification-code delivery and validation through platform libraries, then retrieves the resulting verified resources from user- or team-scoped repositories. It maps provider failures and invalid verification outcomes to NestJS HTTP exceptions, while exposing paginated lookup operations and preserving separate user and team ownership paths.
module.businessContext: Supports account and team contact verification for the scheduling platform. Failures can prevent users from confirming contact channels or managing verified resources.
